scope.task: Audit archived extraction content and lean shared author guidance; define conditional category evaluation requirements.
scope.evidence_boundary: All six complete archived extractions were read, including properties, roles, effects, flows, scopes, corrections, unknowns and every distinct embedded evidence item. Repeated identical evidence was deduplicated only for inspection. Archived review verdicts and pertinent review explanations were inspected. No fresh paper retrieval, image inspection, wet-lab validation or independent full-paper verification was performed.
scope.status_meaning: preserved means explicitly represented in this archived extraction with its embedded source support; it is not fresh scientific acceptance. unresolved names a bounded evidence/interpretation gap. No current-output scientific contradiction was established by this annotation audit.
scope.comparison_limit: The six examples are development cases from three inventory categories. Category membership does not establish a shared mechanism, representativeness, or causal prompt superiority. New compact-author outputs were not yet available to this audit.
scope.display_limit: No live UI or rendered display was inspected. Potential display-only failures below mean facts already exist in assertions and must be sought in the display before calling them extraction omissions.
scope.changes: One new audit JSON only. No production, baseline, contract, plan, source or job changes.

issue_types.ambiguity: A scientific or attribution meaning remains unclear; a different wording alone is not an error.
issue_types.evidence_insufficiency: The registered evidence does not establish the consequential claim at the requested level, including source-quality limitations.
issue_types.actual_contradiction: Incompatible asserted claims/routes, or explicitly identified source conflicts. Resolved source conflicts are not current-output contradictions.
issue_types.display_only: A supported assertion exists but is not visible in a display. This audit flags candidates, not verified UI defects.
issue_types.explanation_field_placement: Extractor/source-reading narration occupies scientific explanation fields; moving it must preserve scientific qualifications.
issue_types.representation_repetition: Equivalent local processing is repeated. This is a simplification candidate, not proof of scientific error.

essential_conditional_requirements.when: A physical chromatin preparation is processed.
essential_conditional_requirements.requirement: Identify preparation and physical context, including any fixation or compartment needed for the selected mechanism.
essential_conditional_requirements.check: Trace starting State properties and the first transformation; do not interchange native nuclei, fixed chromatin and purified DNA.

essential_conditional_requirements.when: A selection or proximity-recording step is present.
essential_conditional_requirements.requirement: State what actually creates the selectivity or record and on which molecular substrate.
essential_conditional_requirements.check: For accessibility inspect preferential Tn5 insertion; for contact capture inspect fixation, restriction boundaries, covalent junction formation and target-probe capture separately.

essential_conditional_requirements.when: The resulting library represents a biological association.
essential_conditional_requirements.requirement: Name the sequenced carrier and distinguish it from proteins, probes, affinity handles and former associations.
essential_conditional_requirements.check: Trace association changes into the DNA library and read data, including where a physical protein association becomes a covalent DNA junction.

essential_conditional_requirements.when: Sequence positions, lengths or junction abundance are interpreted.
essential_conditional_requirements.requirement: Explain their supported measurement meaning and consequential selectivity/resolution limits.
essential_conditional_requirements.check: Accessibility is preferential; contact frequency is not functional proof. Raw sequence observations must not silently become analyzed coordinates or filtered contact counts.

essential_conditional_requirements.when: A shared card or conflicting source supplies the route.
essential_conditional_requirements.requirement: Keep assigned member history and supported corrections consistent in States, Operations and Flows.
essential_conditional_requirements.check: A corrected order must be implemented. Shared headings do not transfer another member's labeling chemistry or quantitative efficiency.

non_requirements: No common mechanism for ATAC-seq and Capture-C.
No required extra node per chemistry detail or downstream analysis.
No exact performance/yield claim inferred from a shared catalogue.

essential_conditional_requirements.when: Input selection or preparation limits the represented DNA population.
essential_conditional_requirements.requirement: Record the selected population and the actual selection basis.
essential_conditional_requirements.check: Distinguish chromatin-mark ChIP from methylated-DNA affinity enrichment and from methylase conversion within one DNA preparation.

essential_conditional_requirements.requirement: Describe relevant original base states, treatment changes and resulting sequence calls, with the applicable sequence context.
essential_conditional_requirements.check: Check each treatment/control history; an original chemical mark is not automatically present in PCR copies.

essential_conditional_requirements.when: Different original states share the same output.
essential_conditional_requirements.requirement: State which original states remain indistinguishable or explicitly retain unsupported specificity as unresolved.
essential_conditional_requirements.check: Do not infer separate modification calls from a combined C/T channel; do not import absent 5hmC-specific evidence from another method.

essential_conditional_requirements.when: A control, comparison or incomplete reaction affects interpretation.
essential_conditional_requirements.requirement: Preserve condition-specific local effects and consequential protection/conversion limitations.
essential_conditional_requirements.check: Do not assign M.SssI protection to the untreated control or invent obligatory subtraction. Do not describe the idealized code as perfect chemical conversion.

essential_conditional_requirements.when: Selection history or original chromatin context survives into the readout.
essential_conditional_requirements.requirement: Specify its carrier and resolution after material is removed or copied.
essential_conditional_requirements.check: ChIP fraction of origin can remain attributable after histones are removed; chromatin-fragment resolution differs from methylation base-call resolution.

non_requirements: No mandatory ChIP, methylase, control or single common methylation mechanism across the category.
No forced physical separation of different base classes.
No exact reagent recipe or conversion percentage unless needed for the scoped claim.

essential_conditional_requirements.when: Identity tags or compartments support attribution.
essential_conditional_requirements.requirement: Identify the unit, carrier and supported association at each change in attribution.
essential_conditional_requirements.check: Distinguish molecule/strand family, well, cell and sample identity; a barcode alone does not establish unique identity.

essential_conditional_requirements.when: Tagging, PCR or redistribution determines identity.
essential_conditional_requirements.requirement: Record when tags attach and how identities survive amplification and any physical pooling.
essential_conditional_requirements.check: Duplex tags precede PCR; scATAC first well index precedes intact-nucleus pooling and second index follows redistribution/lysis.

essential_conditional_requirements.when: Independent processing, a physical pool or a data collection is present.
essential_conditional_requirements.requirement: Keep unit-to-output correspondence recoverable and distinguish material organization from data grouping.
essential_conditional_requirements.check: Opposite strand families can coexist in one library/data State. Independently indexed wells can be compact collections only if the two splits, two pools and local barcode histories remain explicit.

essential_conditional_requirements.when: A computational readout or consensus yields the result.
essential_conditional_requirements.requirement: Explain the observation-to-result step without turning a dataset into a physical fraction.
essential_conditional_requirements.check: SSCS and DCS are computed sequence datasets; combinatorial index reads support cell grouping while chromatin DNA carries accessibility information.

essential_conditional_requirements.when: Residual error, collision or incomplete recovery changes the result.
essential_conditional_requirements.requirement: Retain the relevant failure mode and its stage-specific limit.
essential_conditional_requirements.check: SSCS can retain first-cycle errors; DCS needs both partner strands and concordance. Cell-index collisions remain possible and reported rates are implementation-specific.

non_requirements: No forced UMIs or cell barcodes on every low-level assay.
No shared error-correction mechanism between Duplex Sequencing and scATAC.
No required fixed well count, branch count, family threshold or universal collision rate.

essential_assessments.conclusion: Prepared unfixed nuclei with native chromatin are explicitly recorded.

A1.quote: we hypothesized that transposition by purified Tn5, a prokaryotic transposase, on small numbers of unfixed eukaryotic nuclei would interrogate regions of accessible chromatin.

A2.quote: Hyperactive Tn5 transposase10,11, loaded in vitro with adapters for high-throughput DNA sequencing, can simultaneously fragment and tag a genome with sequencing adapters (previously described as “tagmentation”11).

A3.quote: ATAC-seq uses Tn5 transposase to integrate its adapter payload into regions of accessible chromatin, whereas steric hindrance less accessible chromatin makes transposition less probable. Therefore, amplifiable DNA fragments suitable for high-throughput sequencing are preferentially generated at locations of open chromatin (Fig 1a).

A4.quote: We found that ATAC-seq paired-end reads produce detailed information about nucleosome packing and positioning. The insert size distribution of sequenced fragments from human chromatin has clear periodicity of approximately 200 base pairs, suggesting many fragments are protected by integer multiples of nucleosomes (Fig 2a).

A5.quote: Reads were aligned to hg19 using BOWTIE36

The targeted regions capture several different types of molecule. Some are

First, the resolution of a 3C assay depends both on the frequency with
which the restriction enzyme used cuts within the genome, and also the size of

D2.quote: Following ligation of tagged adapters to sheared DNA, the individually labeled strands are PCR amplified from asymmetric primer sites on the adapter tails (Fig. 1B) and subjected to paired-end sequencing. D3.locator: Figure 1B legend — tag/primer arrangement in the two PCR families (registered text chars 8542:8967, end exclusive)
D3.quote: PCR amplification with primers containing Illumina flow-cell–compatible tails is carried out to generate families of PCR duplicates. PCR products originating from the complementary strand are labeled reciprocally.

D4.quote: Comparing the sequences obtained from both strands eliminates errors introduced during the first round of PCR where an artifactual mutation may be propagated to all PCR duplicates of one strand and would not be removed by SSCS filtering alone.

D5.quote: Next, partner strands among SSCS reads were identified by virtue of the complementary tag sequences.
